0_own_gradient_gate.method: complex-step derivatives on 12 random symmetric directions of a random n 8 slab; the stack's grad (u part) plus R0's V4 gradient at the audited weight as a second opinion
0_own_gradient_gate.note: the own gradient is exact to 4.1e-13 (complex step) and agrees with the stack to 7.2e-17

1_rows_recomputed.method: own slab energy (own open-end sym stencil, own eta algebra, own V4 traces) on every stored end field; own eigen-decompositions for the channels; the stack's e_parts as a second opinion on one field
1_rows_recomputed.note: every stored T, T / T_bps and channel reproduced to 1e-8 with the OPEN-END stencil along z (a periodic z stencil shifts T by up to 5.0e-06): the slab is not periodic in z; the stored z_variation is max |M(z) - M(z_0)| and the director_row is the max entry, not norms

2_ladder_reading.method: the claim's ranges tested on the auditor's own recomputed T / T_bps and channels
2_ladder_reading.note: the four delta ranges, the h 0.03 pair, M_0i = 0, the row under 1e-2 and the diagonal range hold; the w spread at fixed delta is 1.10 / 0.86 / 0.79 / 0.66 percent at delta 0.01 / 0.03 / 0.1 / 0.3 (over 1 percent at delta 0.01, ordered with the core radius 1.68 to 3.44 units at h 1: the lattice factor, not the physics); the wording 'the departure is in the DIAGONAL slots' misses the pair mean (s = (l+ + l-) / 2 shifts by up to 5.4e-03 of delta) and the z variation (peak to peak up to 1.1e-02 of delta), both above the director row

3a_K_eff_sympy.method: own sympy: residuals of the four trace targets linearized in x = f - f0 with the two (and three) slots shifted, the quadratic form minimized in closed form
3a_K_eff_sympy.note: K_eff(s0) reproduced exactly (the difference simplifies to 0), limit 3.0393; the M_33 shift coefficient is -0.2436 in the limit (the record's -0.25 is a rounding) and -0.4365 at delta 0.3, M_00 shift 4.3e-04; a THIRD slot (the pair mean s) lowers the quadratic stiffness further to 2.976 in the limit (0.9791 of K_eff2), so K_eff is not the stack's stiffness either

3b_T_slaved_integral.method: own least-squares slaved potential (2 and 3 slots), own 160-node Gauss-Legendre Bogomolny integral, own axis solution against the measured axis shift of the h 1 rows
3b_T_slaved_integral.note: T_slaved and its four ratios reproduced (worst 2.4e-05), w-independent; the measured axis shift of M_33 sits 3.9/3.7/2.7/2.0 percent above the two-slot 1D solution at delta 0.01/0.03/0.1/0.3 (the record's 'to 2 percent' holds at delta 0.3 only) and -2.3/-2.0/-1.9/-1.5 percent off the three-slot one; a third slaved slot (the pair mean) lowers the bound to 0.9901/0.9911/0.9935/0.9935 of T_slaved2, and the measured pair-mean axis shift is 0.99 of that slot's prediction at delta 0.3: T_slaved is not a bound on the stack, T_slaved3 is the radial-ansatz value

3c_commutation.method: own lattice field with the pair winding and radial m00, m33, s profiles versus the frozen field: E_u compared by the own stencil energy; own sympy on block-diagonal A_x, A_y
3c_commutation.note: no extra kinetic term at round-off (0.0e+00 relative) for M_00, M_33 AND the pair mean s (the identity in the pair block commutes with the winding as well); a shift confined to one pair-diagonal entry, the control, does couple (6.5e-01 relative)

3d_channel_projections.method: own projections of the stored end fields (z average, director row zeroed, pair mean reset, diagonal slots frozen) with the own energy
3d_channel_projections.note: freezing M_33 and M_00 raises T to 1.966 of the stored value at delta 0.3 (the deficit sits there); the z average and the director row are energetically INERT (both projections move T by under 2.2e-05 relative on the four fields: unrelaxed kick residue, neither a channel nor a cost); resetting the pair mean to s0 RAISES T by 0.82 to 0.95 percent: the pair mean IS a relaxation channel of the stack that the two-slot bound does not carry

4_label_rule.method: the pre-registered rule re-applied by the auditor to the rows' verdicts, ratios and departures; the gate recomputed per row
4_label_rule.note: UNRESOLVED follows the rule (no AT_GATE row); if the gate clause were waived, 6 (delta, w) pairs at h 1 with their h 0.5 twins satisfy the LEAVES condition: ['d0.03_w25_n48_L48', 'd0.3_w25_n48_L48', 'd0.03_w25_n72_L72', 'd0.3_w25_n72_L72', 'd0.03_w25_n96_L96', 'd0.3_w25_n96_L96']; the closest approach to the gate is fmax / gate = 2885 (see 3e for whether the gate is reachable)

4b_round_off_floors.method: own scan of E and grad . D along a random static direction of amplitude 1e-6 delta on the stored fields (21 points), the residual of a quadratic (E) and a linear (grad) fit; the gradient at the exact vacuum
4b_round_off_floors.note: energy floor {'d0.01_w6.25_n48_L48': '2.6e-10', 'd0.03_w25_n48_L48': '2.5e-11', 'd0.1_w25_n48_L48': '1.5e-12', 'd0.3_w25_n48_L48': '1.1e-13'} relative; gradient floor per entry {'d0.01_w6.25_n48_L48': '5.0e-12', 'd0.03_w25_n48_L48': '2.3e-11', 'd0.1_w25_n48_L48': '3.7e-11', 'd0.3_w25_n48_L48': '8.5e-11'} against the gate {'d0.01_w6.25_n48_L48': '1.0e-13', 'd0.03_w25_n48_L48': '2.4e-13', 'd0.1_w25_n48_L48': '3.0e-11', 'd0.3_w25_n48_L48': '2.7e-09'}: the gate sits within a decade of the round-off floor on ['d0.01_w6.25_n48_L48', 'd0.03_w25_n48_L48', 'd0.1_w25_n48_L48'] (the V4 traces tr N^p are differences of O(8^p) numbers, so their residuals carry an absolute floor that does not shrink with delta)

6_h_L_ladders.method: own fit y0 + c h^p on the four h points of T / T_slaved, triplet orders, the L spread at h 1
6_h_L_ladders.note: delta 0.3: T / T_slaved = 0.9837, 0.9892, 0.9911, 0.9925 at h 1.5, 1, 0.75, 0.5, fit order 2.05 with y_inf 0.9935 against the THIRD-slot bound's 0.9935 of T_slaved; divided by the BPS profile's own lattice factor the ratio reads 0.9992, 0.9962, 0.9951, 0.9942 (falling with finer h); L 48 / 72 / 96 agree to 1.4e-05; delta 0.03: fit order 1.92, y_inf 0.9918 against the third slot's 0.9911, L spread 1.2e-04. The h extrapolation lands on the three-slot 1D value, so the 1 to 2 percent under T_slaved at h 0.5 is the pair-mean channel plus the lattice factor, not the unconverged descent; every h point carries a FALLING or a stall verdict, so no order is a converged statement

7_ten_entry_witness.method: the fullkick JSON rows read; the own energy (no gradient) on one stored fullkick array; own entry magnitudes
7_ten_entry_witness.note: the end fields are boost textures (M_0i, M_00 and the pair block at 2e+03) and the functional itself is at -9.2e+14 per unit length on the stored field (E_u -1.0e+15, V4 8.0e+13); the stored E_end values run -2.0e+13 to -4.9e+16 (the record's '-1e15 to -1e24' overstates the range); the certified static action is unbounded below on unconstrained time-space components, which are not the Hamiltonian's static sector (M_0i = 0 is an invariant subspace of the static descent), so this sector is not the static measurement's

3e_own_descent.method: own scaled L-BFGS (variables M / delta, energy / (T_bps nz h), ftol 0, gtol 1e-16, own exact gradient, shell and time row frozen) continued from the stored end fields, up to 1500 iterations (three times that at delta 0.3)
